name: Salmon Parmesan Fritters with Salsa & Bell Pepper-Ranch Mixed Greens

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ yellow bell peppers
1 ½ (142 g) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Divide between two large bowls; set one bowl aside for later use.
Drain salmon and flake with a fork. Add to the bowl with the cilantro along with eggs, bread crumbs, Parmesan, chili powder, and salt. Stir to combine the salmon mixture.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 (213 g) cans wild pink salmon, traditional style
6 eggs
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
¾ cup Parmesan cheese, shredded
1 tbsp chili powder
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: ¼ cup extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Working in batches, using a ⅓-cup measure, drop salmon mixture into the skillet, spacing scoops a few inches apart; press down to form round fritters. Cook, flipping once, until fritters are golden brown, about 3 minutes. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate.
Meanwhile, trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the remaining bowl with the cilantro along with the mixed greens. Stir to combine the salad.
Divide fritters and salad between plates; drizzle salad with dressing. Serve with salsa on the side and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup ranch dressing
1 ½ cup salsa
